name: PriorBarAtrTrailingStop
longCondition: el_gt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && armed && el_le(close[0], low[1] - stopOffsetTicks * tickSize - stopOffsetAtr * atrVal)
shortCondition: el_lt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && armed && el_ge(close[0], high[1] + stopOffsetTicks * tickSize + stopOffsetAtr * atrVal)
